name: Cursor Cloud Agents
description: Expose Cursor Cloud Agents tools to the Mattermost Agents plugin via MCP.

settings_schema.header: The service account key below powers MCP tools for the Mattermost Agents plugin.

settings.help_text: Used for all MCP tool calls made through the Mattermost Agents plugin, so invoking users do not need their own Cursor access. Create a service account key from the Cursor Dashboard.
Override for testing. Leave empty to use https://api.cursor.com.

Optional. Cursor model ID used when the Agents bot does not request a specific model (for example, claude-4.6-sonnet-thinking). Leave empty to let Cursor pick the user, team, then system default. Find valid IDs with the list_models tool or the Cursor Dashboard.

Optional JSON array of model parameters applied with the Default Model ID, such as [{"id":"thinking","value":"high"}]. Requires a Default Model ID. These apply only when the resolved model matches the Default Model ID. Use list_models to discover valid ids and values.
